ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 6
   B. 1, 2, 3, 6
   C. 2, 4, 6
   D. 3, 6, 9

2. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 12.5
   C. 6
   D. 5

3. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 24

4. Solve for x: x + 6 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 6
   C. 6
   D. 5

5. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

6. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 24
   D. 42

7. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

8. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

9. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.6
   C. 31.7
   D. 37

10. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 32
   C. 12
   D. 4

11. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.7
   C. 19
   D. 19.6

12. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 81

13. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 2
   C. 25
   D. 10

14. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 31
   C. 27
   D. 17

15. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 6x + 2

16. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 105
   B. 22
   C. 44
   D. 30

17. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 7
   C. 1
   D. 12

18. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

19. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 22
   C. 77
   D. 36

20. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 4
   C. 32
   D. 33

21. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 56
   C. 15
   D. 57

22. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 13
   C. 26
   D. 170

23. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 7
   C. 49
   D. 50

24. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15
   C. 15.7
   D. 21

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
